Files cover bitwise AND (bvand.lisp), subtraction (bvminus.lisp), modulo (bvmod.lisp), multiplication (bvmult.lisp), OR (bvor.lisp), addition (bvplus.lisp), logcount (logcount.lisp), sign extension (logext.lisp), repeatbit (repeatbit.lisp), signed division (sbvdiv-rules.lisp, sbvdivdown-rules.lisp), signed modulo (sbvmoddown.lisp), and signed remainder (sbvrem-rules.lisp, sbvrem.lisp). None are pure import aggregators; all contain unique formal mathematical declarations and proofs.
